rootCause.finding: The fetched SEC company_tickers.json snapshot did not contain a canonical LANC match, while an SEC EDGAR filing authoritatively identifies the issuer, ticker and CIK.

decision.ordinaryMappingPriority: SEC company_tickers.json remains primary when it agrees with authoritative evidence.
decision.conflictPolicy: Reject a CIK conflict; never silently prefer an override.
decision.fallbackPolicy: Use a non-expired SEC-authoritative registry entry only when the ordinary official mapping has no ticker match.
